name: Lehi Cerna
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Reaching out for counselling can sometimes feel like a big step. My approach is to make that step a little easier by providing a warm, respectful and down-to-earth space where you can talk openly, without judgement. I am an ACA Level 4 Registered Counsellor with extensive experience supporting people through personal challenges, difficult life circumstances, relationships, workplace concerns, stress, change and periods when life simply feels overwhelming.

name: Linette Etheredge
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: At Release me Therapy, we offer a safe therapeutic space where individuals and those in relationships can share their story, explore their feelings, deepen self-understanding and begin healing. Linette Etheredge draws on evidence and trauma informed approaches including mindfulness, psychoeducation, Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT), Narrative Therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) to meet your individual needs and goals. As we gently attend to any grieving or tender parts of self, you’ll be supported to foster a more compassionate and intimate relationship with yourself and in time, experience more satisfying intimate connections with others. In our practice, we welcome people from all backgrounds, abilities, sexual preference, gender identity and relationship structures while supporting adults and young people aged 12+ to feel better, make changes and live their best lives!

name: Luke Pepperell
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: I bring a grounded, practical and non judgemental approach to counselling, shaped by both professional experience and a real world understanding of the challenges people face throughout life. Over the past five years, I have worked closely with individuals and families connected to the prison system, supporting people navigating addiction, relationship difficulties, emotional distress, identity challenges and family disconnection. This experience has strengthened my ability to build genuine rapport with people from all walks of life and create a space where clients feel heard, respected and understood.

name: Lynda Carlyle
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Lynda Carlyle’s qualifications in the complementary areas of nursing, sexology, counselling, and couple’s therapy provide her with a breadth of knowledge to draw from. In a warm and encouraging space, Lynda offers a platform to share hopes and disappointments about sex, relationships, and life. For more than a decade, Lynda Carlyle has been working with people seeking understanding and help for problems with sex and intimacy , sexual problems / dysfunctions , and relationship issues . Her innovative and practical ideas can reduce anxiety, improve confidence with sex, help with sexual functioning, and increase sexual pleasure.
